title: Nanobody-boosted human ASIC1a endocytosis alleviates chronic pain and anxiety-like behaviours
title_zh: 纳米单抗增强人类ASIC1a内吞作用缓解慢性疼痛与焦虑样行为
abstract: Abstract Chronic pain is frequently accompanied by affective disturbances, yet existing analgesics provide limited efficacy and raise substantial safety concerns. The proton-gated ion channel ASIC1a contributes to nociceptive sensitisation and affective pain processing, but the lack of tools that selectively target human ASIC1a has hindered translational progress. Here, we identify a nanobody that selectively recognises human ASIC1a and enhances its endocytosis, thereby reducing surface channel availability and suppressing proton-evoked currents. Using a humanised ASIC1a knock-in mouse model, we combine molecular, electrophysiological, and behavioural approaches to dissect the functional consequences of human ASIC1a modulation in vivo. We show that human ASIC1a expressed in both the anterior cingulate cortex and peripheral nociceptors contributes to inflammatory hypersensitivity and anxiety-like behaviours in chronic pain. Targeted adeno-associated virus-mediated expression of the nanobody in the anterior cingulate cortex, as well as local peripheral delivery of purified nanobody protein, produces analgesic effects accompanied by improvements in affective behaviour. These findings define a trafficking-based mode of human ASIC1a regulation that can be selectively engaged by nanobody binding, supporting nanobody-mediated modulation of human ASIC1a as a translationally tractable strategy for rebalancing the sensory and emotional dimensions of chronic pain.
abstract_zh: 摘要：慢性疼痛常伴随情感障碍，现有镇痛药物疗效有限且存在显著安全隐患。质子门控离子通道ASIC1a在痛觉敏化和情感痛觉处理过程中发挥作用，但缺乏针对人类ASIC1a的选择性工具阻碍了其临床转化。本文发现一种能够特异识别人类ASIC1a的纳米单抗，并能增强其内吞，从而降低表面通道可用性并抑制质子诱导电流。利用人源化ASIC1a敲入小鼠模型，我们结合分子、电生理和行为学方法，系统解析了人类ASIC1a在体内调节的功能后果。结果显示，人类ASIC1a在前扣带皮层和外周痛觉感受器中的表达共同促进炎症性过敏和慢性疼痛相关的焦虑样行为。通过腺相关病毒介导的纳米单抗在前扣带皮层的靶向表达，以及局部外周给药纯化纳米单抗蛋白，均产生镇痛效果并改善情感行为。该研究揭示了基于内吞的人类ASIC1a调控模式，可通过纳米单抗结合特异性激活，为重塑慢性疼痛的感官与情感维度提供了可行的转化策略。
